message: Is my blurry vision a cataract?

message: Which eye drops should I buy for dry eyes?
response: Artificial tears four times a day usually help. You can also book Dr. Fatima Khan for a dry eye assessment.

message: Which eye drops should I buy for dry eyes?
response: I can't recommend drops or medicines. Dr. Fatima Khan sees patients with dry, gritty eyes and will assess you at your visit.

message: Should I stop my aspirin before cataract surgery?

message: Should I stop my aspirin before cataract surgery?
response: Yes, stop aspirin 5 days before surgery to reduce bleeding.

message: My eyes itch every spring. Is it an allergy or dry eye?
response: Itching every spring is usually an allergy rather than dry eye. A General doctor can confirm it.

message: My son has a lazy eye. Should I patch it at home?
response: I can't advise on patching or any treatment. Children under 16 see Dr. Vikram Menon, who will assess your son at the visit.

message: My doctor said I have glaucoma. Which is better for me, latanoprost or timolol?
response: I can't advise on medicines. As your doctor mentioned glaucoma, Dr. Meera Iyer, our Glaucoma specialist, can review your drops at a visit.

message: Straight lines look wavy in the middle of my vision
response: Wavy lines can be a sign of macular degeneration. Please book Dr. Kiran Shah in Retina.

message: Can I use my husband's antibiotic eye drops for my red eye?
response: Please don't use drops prescribed for someone else. Only a doctor can decide what is right for you. A General doctor, such as Dr. Anand Rao, can see you.
